OzyVTT · polish · consistency sweep

Consistency sweep

Every side list, title row, menu, phone sheet and dialog in the 23 approved mockups, captured as each mockup draws it and grouped by pattern. 76 captures. An amber frame and number mark a capture that differs from the rest of its pattern; the findings below say how, and what would bring it in line.

What doesn't match

Seven differences, most to least visible. Tell me which fixes to make, by number.

1

Settings' side list in two older mockups

Settings (I) and Time and tools still draw Settings' list with tall two-line rows. ADR-0071 replaced that with the settled list, as Settings' leftovers draws it.

Fix: redraw both mockups' list as Settings' leftovers does. Their specs already carry the amendment.

2

The Downtime tab's characters have no faces

Every other side list gives each row an icon. The Downtime tab's characters are bare names with their days.

Fix: give each character their face at 20 px, as the party's rows do elsewhere.

3

Where a title row's crumb sits

An encounter, a Codex page and a Compendium record put the crumb on the same line as the title (‹ PEOPLE SISTER ILSA VARN). Prep templates, the calendar, a table screen's remote and a credential's page put it on its own line above.

Fix: crumb inline before the title everywhere, with the back chevron, as the Codex and the Compendium do.

4

How a menu opens

The map's menus open with the thing's name in capitals and its line (GOBLIN BOSS · Monster · 15/21). The Atlas pin's menu and the Maps and Tokens menus open with a small eyebrow instead.

Fix: a menu about one thing opens with its name and line, as the map's do. A menu that offers a choice (File it under) keeps its eyebrow.

5

How a phone sheet opens

Three sheets (a creature, the encounter's options, a party member) open with a grab handle and no close. The rest open with a title and a close button, no handle. Level up has neither.

Fix: every sheet opens with the handle, then its title and the close button.

6

Counts in a side list's eyebrow

The Atlas's list says MAPS · 4 in its eyebrow. Every other side list keeps its counts on the rows.

Fix: MAPS, without the count.

7

The Atlas tree's rows

The tree's rows carry no icon and show a word at the right (world, battle, 5 pins) where other lists show a number.

Fix: a map icon on each row and the pin count as the number; the kind moves to the map's line. Or keep the tree as it is, since it nests.

Nothing else differs: the side lists in Maps, the token picker, the sound board, the pages index, quests, the Compendium and the templates read one way; the dialogs share one head with the horizon edge.
